name: Ring of Elemental Command (Water)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dominate an Water Elemental
powers.text: 2 charges: cast Dominate Monster (save DC 18) on an Water Elemental.

summary: Command over Water elementals, Resistance to Cold damage, and its element's spells (save DC 18).
text: Linked with the Elemental Plane of Water, this ring gives your attack rolls against Water Elementals Advantage, while their attack rolls against you have Disadvantage. You also gain Resistance to Cold damage, a Swim Speed of 60 feet, the ability to breathe underwater, and the Aquan language. It holds 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 of them at each dawn. For 2 charges you can target a Water Elemental with Dominate Monster (save DC 18). Other spells it casts, with their charge costs: Wall Of Ice (3), Control Water (3), Ice Storm (2), Create Or Destroy Water (1).
